title: EngineQueueJob
description: Mirrors apps/api/src/lib/engineQueue.ts's EngineQueueJob union by hand — the job payloads apps/api enqueues on the 'engine-jobs' BullMQ queue and apps/interview-engine's Python consumer (engine/voice/consumer.py) picks up, distinguished by BullMQ's own job name ('engine-start', 'noshow-check', or 'cv-parse').

oneOf.title: EngineStartJob
oneOf.description: Enqueued for scheduledAt minus 2 minutes — the engine prepares the room. The candidate's CV is normally already parsed by a prior CvParseJob (Candidate.cvParsedJson); everything else the engine needs (role blueprint, question bank) it looks up from Postgres directly by these ids — see apps/interview-engine/engine/db.py.

oneOf.title: NoShowCheckJob
oneOf.description: Enqueued for scheduledAt plus 15 minutes — marks the session NO_SHOW if it never actually started (Phase 8).

oneOf.title: CvParseJob
oneOf.description: Enqueued the moment a candidate is added, not tied to any interview — parses the CV into structured JSON (skills, experience, seniority) and saves it to Candidate.cvParsedJson, ahead of any interview being scheduled. Keeps the slow LLM call out of EngineStartJob's 2-minute lead time.
